sources.snippet: The ONNX post-processing step that merges the decoder fails for large models due to the protobuf 2GB size limit. The separate decoder_model.onnx and decoder_with_past_model.onnx files are used instead — this is handled automatically by Optimum and does not affect functionality or accuracy.
